column9: Behavior is Not Enough: A Mechanism-Based Evaluation of Social Norm Emergence in LLM Societies
column10: Social norms cannot be identified from behavior alone: the same cooperative equilibrium may reflect shared expectations, strategic incentives, or simple imitation. Yet in multi-agent large language model systems, prior work largely treats behavioral convergence as evidence of norm emergence.
